paragraphs: I honestly don't know where to start, so I'm just going to start. (You know I overthink these things.)
Some people walk into your life and everything shifts a little. And then there are people like you, who make even the most ordinary days feel like they matter.

I love that I can talk to you about literally anything. One minute we're deep into life, love, society, politics, philosophy, and the next minute we're talking about something so ridiculous I couldn't explain it to anyone else. And you're somehow equally good company in both.

Thank you for listening. Again and again and again. Thank you for tolerating me, for not judging me, for letting me say half-formed thoughts out loud without editing myself first. (And thank you for putting up with me torturing you sometimes. I'm not promising to stop. 😌)

You have this soft, steady way of making people feel safe, and I don't think you realise how rare that is. With you, Chuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuba 💙, I can just be me. Do you know what a gift that is?
I love our conversations. I love the laughter, the chaos, the songs, the movies, and all the little in-between moments that nobody else would understand.
You're gorgeous, Chuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuba 💜, inside and out. I hope you're as gentle with yourself as you are with everyone else.

I hope life gives you kindness that never runs out, happiness that stays, people who see you the way I see you, and a life as beautiful as your heart. And selfishly, I hope I get to be in many more chapters of it.
signature:
With so much love,
Oviya B. 💜
